{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''backwater planet''' hosted a vital [[Imperial communications hub]] on [[Sunfall Peak]]. A [[Unidentified resistance group (backwater planet)|resistance group]] fought the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] presence there before joining with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to stage a [[Mission to Sunfall Peak|raid]] on the hub.<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The planet first appears in the opening short story of the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2014]].<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook" />
